item.title: State Department says China is wrongfully detaining US citizen
item.description: The State Department announced Thursday that an American who went to China has been illegally detained by that country's government.

item.title: Iran dismisses Trump's 'economic D-Day' threat as 'failed policies'
item.description: Iran downplayed President Trump's warning of an 'economic D-Day' as a continuation of unsuccessful approaches.

item.title: FBI seizes former Rep. Swalwell's devices in criminal probe
item.description: Sources say the FBI took electronic devices belonging to former Democratic Rep. Eric Swalwell as part of an ongoing investigation.

item.title: Royal experts analyze Harry and Meghan's potential UK return
item.description: Experts Robert Jobson and Victoria Murphy discuss the implications of Prince Harry and Meghan's planned move back to the UK.
